title: A Pre-trained Variational Autoencoder for Gyrokinetic Plasma Turbulence Surrogate Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2609.38438v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning surrogate models offer a promising path toward accelerating plasma turbulence simulations. We present PreVAE-Turb, a surrogate modeling framework that leverages pre-trained variational autoencoders (VAEs) from the Stable Diffusion image generation model for efficient spatial compression of turbulence fields. The pre-trained VAE is fine-tuned on turbulence data using a physics-informed loss function that includes a spectral loss operating in Fourier space to enforce spectral accuracy across scales. The VAE is combined with convolutional long short-term memory (ConvLSTM) networks to learn temporal dynamics in latent space, with a manifold consistency error metric that monitors encode--decode consistency during autoregressive rollouts. We validate the framework on two-dimensional Hasegawa-Wakatani drift-wave turbulence and extend it to gyrokinetic turbulence from the GENE code, where a four-channel adaptation simultaneous

translated_title: 用于回旋动理学等离子体湍流代理建模的预训练变分自编码器
translated_abstract: 机器学习代理模型为加速等离子体湍流模拟提供了一条有前景的途径。我们提出了 PreVAE-Turb，这是一种代理建模框架，它利用来自 Stable Diffusion 图像生成模型的预训练变分自编码器（VAE）对湍流场进行高效的空间压缩。该预训练 VAE 在湍流数据上进行微调，采用包含物理信息的损失函数，其中包括在傅里叶空间中运作的光谱损失，以确保跨尺度的光谱精度。该 VAE 与卷积长短期记忆网络相结合，在潜空间中学习时间动力学，并引入流形一致性误差指标来监控自回归滚动预测过程中的编解码一致性。我们在二维 Hasegawa-Wakatani 漂移波湍流上验证了该框架，并将其扩展至来自 GENE 代码的回旋动理学湍流，其中采用四通道自适应方案同时……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 PreVAE-Turb 框架，创新性地将 Stable Diffusion 中的预训练变分自编码器迁移至湍流场空间压缩，结合 ConvLSTM 学习潜空间时间动力学，实现了高效精确的回旋动理学等离子体湍流代理建模。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes PreVAE-Turb, a surrogate framework that repurposes the pre-trained VAE from Stable Diffusion for spatial compression of turbulence fields and couples it with ConvLSTM to learn latent temporal dynamics, enabling efficient and accurate gyrokinetic plasma turbulence surrogate modeling.
